links.outcome: AUROC of AI sepsis prediction versus traditional scoring systems on same prospective cohort
links.effect: VC-SEPS AUROC 0.880, superior to traditional scoring systems; predicted sepsis on average 68.05 min before operational-definition diagnosis.
links.quote: The area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of VC-SEPS was 0.880, indicating its superiority over traditional scoring systems.

screen.reason: Prospective observational validation of a deep learning-based sepsis prediction model (VC-SEPS) running on real-world EMR data from hospitalized patients, without evaluating specific deployment guardrails or organizational practices.
